description: The Atlas Nacional de Riesgos is the Mexican national risk atlas portal of the National Centre for Disaster Prevention (CENAPRED). Its National Risk Information System brings together the maps of hazard, exposure, vulnerability and risk by theme for viewing and analysis; it monitors earthquakes, tropical cyclones and the Colima and Popocatépetl volcanoes using information from CENAPRED, the National Seismological Service, LANOT and NOAA; it links the tropical cyclone early warning bulletin; it publishes critical flood points identified and validated by the National Water Commission and state civil protection bodies; and it presents municipal hazard, exposure and vulnerability indicators on the 2020 geostatistical framework. It also covers the 32 state risk atlases and the municipal atlases. Access is free and public; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: a notice on the portal warns of display errors while the system is updated, the page says the critical flood points are not the only places that can flood, and the content is in Spanish. Coverage is Mexico. It supports hazard exposure analysis and emergency response planning for infrastructure facing earthquakes, cyclones, floods and volcanic eruptions; related records are the Italian Civil Protection maps and the NIED bosaiXview maps.
